name: colab-runner
description: Manage local notebook cells and run them on leased Google Colab kernels through the official CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Safe Colab jobs and leased sessions from Codex
interface.longDescription: Inspect and safely edit local notebook cells, execute them on a leased Google Colab kernel through the official CLI, poll bounded background status, retrieve declared artifacts, export replayable logs, and automatically release idle sessions.
defaultPrompt: Run this Python workload safely on Colab and retrieve its artifacts.
Keep a Colab kernel alive while I execute selected notebook cells.
Inspect, update, and run one notebook cell without rerunning the notebook.
Check my active Colab sessions and report anything still consuming compute.
Execute this notebook on a T4 with a hard deadline and export the run log.
